summary: Master pension fund risk management. Learn ALM, VaR, and ESG integration to protect fund solvency and meet fiduciary duties. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Pension fund risk management helps trustees, investment risk analysts, and fund managers assess whether portfolios can meet members’ long-term obligations while managing investment uncertainty. This course develops practical skills in aligning assets with liabilities through liability-driven investment, forecasting solvency with Monte Carlo simulations, and planning liquidity for private-market allocations.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the financial health and regulatory compliance of retirement schemes.
modules: Pension Risk Foundations and Fiduciary Duty
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of financial markets and basic portfolio management concepts. Familiarity with Excel for financial modeling is required, as several exercises involve data manipulation. No prior programming or coding experience is necessary, though an understanding of basic statistical concepts (mean, standard deviation, correlation) will be beneficial for the quantitative modules.
